prompt: This Python package (shopkit) has a model, a serializer, a repository and a service for each entity. Add a field `loyalty_tier` to the Customer model. It is a string and defaults to "standard", so existing code that builds a Customer without it keeps working. Then include it as `loyalty_tier` in the dict returned by serialize_customer. Only the Customer model and its serializer should change. CustomerProfile and CustomerSummary are different entities and stay as they are.
